history.reason: blocking smell "reflect-testlist-defect": reflection gate: NFR-F1-durability-migrations requires each stock record carry an unmodifiable created_at timestamp and actor set by the service and stored immutably by the model, but no test in this story's list verifies that. T12 (invariant_id PI4-migration-reversible) only exercises migration downgrade/upgrade + seeded-row survival; T9 (PI2-required-fields-not-null) round-trips only sku/location/quantity/inventory_code. S1 is the only story that creates stock_records (S2/S3 are read-only), so if the audit-field clause isn't tested here it is never tested anywhere in this feature. Add a fitness test asserting a filed record's created_at/actor are service-set and remain unchanged across a refile (AC3 upsert).

blocking smell "reflect-spec-defect": reflection gate: T6 (kind: behavior, scenario_file tests/features/S1-file-stock-record.feature) tests 'submitting a filing with a negative quantity returns a field-named inline error, not a generic 400 body', but no AC in this story documents that scenario. AC1's given/when/then only covers the happy-path filing-and-confirmation flow (a valid sku/location/quantity/inventory_code for a pair with no existing record); AC2-AC4 cover read-back and refile. Unlike the story's fitness-kind items (T2-T5, T9, T12), which legitimately need no dedicated AC, a behavior-kind item is a Gherkin scenario that must trace to an AC's Given/When/Then, and none exists for the negative-quantity/field-named-validation-error path required by NFR-F1-quantity-integrity's non-negative floor and NFR-F1-field-named-validation. Add an AC (e.g. AC5-negative-quantity-rejected-with-field-named-error) with its own given/when/then, layer, and architectural_notes so T6 has a scenario to test against.
